traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Muntingiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate; veins palmate; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior, half inferior or inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit berry; stamens (11-) 15 to 100; carpels 5 to 7. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
